Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1183
Claimant:
Michael Ochoa
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
2024-09-23
Parking lot collision reported by the insured driver, who is named on the policy. Vehicle damage appears consistent
with the described low-speed contact at the rear bumper.
2024-10-04
Police attended the scene and confirmed the claimant was present in the vehicle at the time. Photos taken at the
scene show the damage and the general layout of the lot.
2024-11-29
Claimant has reported a knee injury and is now represented by counsel. All further contact is to go through the
attorney's office.
2024-11-30
No independent witnesses have come forward. The only accounts on file are from the claimant and the insured driver.
2025-01-15
Checked prior claims history. No earlier damage to the vehicle is recorded, and nothing suggests the damage
predates the coverage start.
2025-01-16
Attorney's demand package received, describing ongoing knee treatment. Medical records requested to review the
diagnosis and treatment course.
2025-02-27
Medical records show an initial evaluation followed by a standard course of physiotherapy. Improvement was noted at
each follow-up visit and the frequency of treatment reduced over time.
2025-03-10
Records reviewed and no prior injury or complaint involving the same knee is noted in the claimant's history. The
severity of the reported injury sitll seems high for an impact of this force.
2025-03-28
Claimant's recorded account has changed slightly since the first interview, with a few added details about the moment
of impact. The core description of the event remains the same.
2025-04-04
Medical opinion requested from the review nurse on whether the injury matches the mechanism described. Response
indicates the treatment was appropriate but the link between the impact and the severity of the injury needs further
review.
2025-04-08
File referred for further review pending the medical opinion and attorney correspondence. No payment decision has
been made at this stage.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
